notes.title: Italian Localization & Passing 50 000 downloads
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

The Flood has passed 50 000 downloads today!
 I'm really happy that so many of you are enjoying the game and it's message.
Thank you for all your support and kind words.

Game now also offers Italian Localization.
Thanks to Joanna Poznańska for her work!

I have also started a small discord server
Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on. Join Discord

Cheers ! ːsteamhappyː
- Ondrej

notes.title: Localization Update & Discord
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I was working on localization update for the past few weeks.
The Flood now also supports these languages:

Chinese
Japanese
Russian
German
Spanish
Turkish
French
Dutch
Czech

Big thanks to everyone who helped !    ːsteamhappyː

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on.  Join Discord Here 

Thank you for all your amazing support and have a nice day!
-Ondrej
